newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips closes U.S. vacuum cleaner unit.
newsitem.headline: Philips closes U.S. vacuum cleaner unit.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said Friday it would shut down its Regina vacuum cleaner operations in the United States.
The company said the move would eliminate 300 jobs at its Regina plant in Long Beach, Miss., where vacuum cleaner production will stop at the end of the year.
Philips will retain ownership of the Regina brand name and may re-establish a position in U.S. floor care in the future.
"Philips will focus on continuing to grow its floor care position in Europe," the company added.
